# classification-metrics

> Classification metrics without numpy: confusion matrix, per-class precision, recall and F1, macro and micro F1, and seeded percentile bootstrap intervals Python package `trysac-classification-metrics`, import name `classification_metrics`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
